paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawt nung uh kum zali-le-sawmgiatna kum, Israelte tung a Solomon lal akum lina, Ziv kha, akha nihna in TOUPA' inn lam apan uhi.
heading: Solomon In Tempul Alam

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia a-inn lam adunglam tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
Huai inn a Mun Siangthou malam a inlim availam tan tong sawmnih a sau ahi a, amalam a pen availam tong sawm ahi.
Inn a ding in tohlet neuchik vathangkalh om in abawl hi.
Huai inn baang kimvel leh tempul baang kimvel in tempul mun baang kimvel leng huai inn baang si in inn chial nei alam hi.

Akimvel in dantan abawl a; achial nuainungpen availam tong nga ahi a, alai a pen availam tong guk ahi. Athumna availam tong sagih ahi. Kalvaite ahihleh inn baang a kigolh akiphamoh kei; inn polam ah akimvel in baang ah akingakna akibawl ziak ahi.
Huai inn alam lai un suang alaihna mun a seksa vek a bawl ahi. Huchi in alam sung un sek ging, heipi ging leh sik vanzat ging huai inn ah zak ahi kei hi.
Dantan laita pente kongpi huai inn taklam pang ah a-om a; alaita ah kahna kivial in akahtou ua, alaita a pan athumna tan ah.
Huchi in huai inn ahon lam a, azou a, inn bel sidar inkam leh apek in akhuh hi.
Inchial neite akisituah vek in tong nga chiat a sang in alam a; huaite sidar sing sige toh apeh hi.
Solomon kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.

"Hiai inn na lam laitak tungtang thu, ka dan thusehte na pom a, ka vaihawmte na zuih a, ka thupiak tengteng zui dia na pom peuhmahleh, na pa David kiang a ka gensa, huai ka thu na tung ah ka hihkip ding.
Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, ka mi Israelte ka limsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in huai inn alam a, azouta hi.
Inn sunglam baang ding in sidar singpek azang a; apialkhang a pan atunglam baang pha in asunglam ah sing abelh vek hi. Apialkhang ding in meilah singpek aphahbeh hi.
heading: Tempul Sunglam Vante Bawlna / (2 Kro 3.8-14)

paite: Inn phaitam lam tong sawmnih pen pialkhang a pan baangte tan in sidar singpek vek in abawl a; biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen a ding in leng asunglam ah azang hi.
Huai inn, abiakna munpi adunglam tong sawmli ahi.
Huai insung lam ah apakmum leh apakpalh limgelh kilawm sidar sing a khuak a-om a; avek in sidar sing vek ahi a; suang himhim muh ahi kei hi.
TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna ding in huai insung ah biakna lam ah mun abawl hi.
Huai, biakna mun sung adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asanlam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; sidar sing a bawl maitam leng aluan hi.
Huchi in Solomon in huai insung dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; biakna mun malam dangka-eng khainiang in adaikaih a; huai dangka-eng in aluan hi,
Huai in avek a azoh pha in apumpi in dangka-eng in aluan tawmtawm hi. Biakna mun maitam pumpi leng dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Biakna mun ah tong sawm tuaktuak a sang, cherub nih olive sing in abawl hi.
Cherub kha khat pen tong nga ahi a, cherub kha langkhat pen tong nga mah ahi. Akha mong khat a pan akha langkhat mong kikal tong sawm ahi.
Cherub khat pen leng tong sawm ahi a; cherubte akikim geih un, akibang geih uhi.
Cherub khat sanlam tong sawm ahi a, cherub khat pen leng huai toh kikim mah ahi.

Cherubte insung gilzaw ah akoih a; cherubte kha akizak a, khat kha in baang langkhat lam ava khoih a, cherub khat pen kha in leng baang langkhat akhoih a; huai inn laitak ah akha uleh akha uh akisukhatuah uhi.
Huai cherubte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Inn baang tengteng akimvel in cherubte, tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm insung lam leh polam ah abawl hi.
A-inn pialkhang sunglam leh polam dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Biakna mun lutna ding in olive sing kongkhak abawl a; kongpi lutung leh kongpi biangte abaang seh nga suah seh khat chiat ahi.
Huchi in olive sing inn kongkhak nih abawl a; huai ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm in abawl hi. Huai dangka-eng in aluan a; cherubte leh tum singte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Tempul lutna ding in abaang seh li suah seh khat chia in olive kongpi khuam abawl lai hi.
Meilah sing kongkhak nih toh; kongkhak khat a pek nihte kheptheih ahi a, kongkhak khat pen apek nih leng kheptheih ahi.
Huaite ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte agelh a; huai gelh kilawm mamtak in dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Tempul huangsung intual sunggilzaw pen suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat in abawl hi.
Akum lina, Ziv kha in TOUPA inn suangphum lep khit ahi.
Akum sawm-le-khatna, Bul kha, akha giatna in huai inn zuih ding bangbang, bangkim mansa vek ahi. Huchi in kum sagih sung alam hi.
